summary.name: Abstract Motion Graphics (explicit provenance; category Motion Design and Cinematography). The style name and direction come from the source. Its primary use is a self-contained shape system.
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: a continuous system built from a few shapes and limited colors, with deliberate proportions and centers of gravity. Repetition, division, merging, rotation and varied timing link each state to the next. Unrelated particles or light effects weaken the motif and should be avoided.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: brand idents, loop backgrounds, abstract section transitions, music visuals and event openers. Inferred: geometric motion posters and product or editorial openers where the shape system itself carries the message. Unspecified: no subject, audience or duration was supplied.
summary.limitations: Explicit: the style is strongest alone and needs hybridization for traceable morphs or audio-driven pacing. Avoid crossfades presented as morphs and glow unrelated to the motif. Source review covered only sampled seconds 1–8 of two external references, with no continuous motion or audio verified.
summary.palette: Explicit: background is scene-dependent. The cream #F6F0E2 is an illustrative swatch, not a required canvas, and no approved exact palette was supplied. Suggested tokens are foreground #283D47, accent #458784 and accent #D28456, status style-compatible suggestion, no gradient. Only foreground/background text (9.997:1) is cleared. Accents are decorative only (3.658 and 3.881). Source review suggests one dominant flat field per section, 1–3 accents and ink that flips for contrast. Recheck composited frames.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: each state leads into the next through repetition, rotation and division, with varied timing. Motion should be deterministic and seekable from composition time. Shared guidance preserves deliberate cuts, impacts and reading holds, and eases only where it helps. Interactive variants may use scroll or hover, but video must not depend on live input.
summary.audio: Unspecified: no audio requirement or asset was supplied. Explicit: audio is optional and no genre or layer is mandated. Inferred options: restrained music tied to a precomputed beat or section map, ambience, or silence where reading holds matter. Beat synchronization requires inspected audio. Source audio was not reviewed.
summary.assetRequirements: Unspecified: no uploads, exact copy, approved mark or brand asset was supplied. Explicit: build reusable shape groups on shared coordinates, load fonts before seeking, and inspect glyph or mark geometry before use. Optional motion references need actual scene elements, such as a punctuation mark, that support their defining action.
summary.combinations: Explicit: style-100 supplies contour-matched morphs with fixed color roles and centers. style-105 supplies musical section and beat structure for density and merging. Optional references: motion-007 (pinned stage), 012 (chaptered handoff), 014 (bounded orb), 015 (story steps), 038 (punctuation zoom), 039 (radial burst). Each applies only when supported. Choosing none is valid.
summary.productionApproach: Explicit ownership: SVG (plus optional p5.js or Paper.js) renders shapes, masks and geometry. GSAP is the default motion engine with one owner per property. HyperFrames handles composition, timing, sync and export; Remotion only under its documented fallback. Optional: chroma-js checks contrast, mo.js adds bursts, and Delaunator adds triangle meshes. Verify forward, backward and direct seeks.
